basic_info.description: Stunning city skyline views from this 1 bed plus den. Open concept layout that integrates living, dining, and kitchen areas. Unique wraparound corner windows in living room perfectly frame the city skyline views. Modern kitchen with Studio Becker cabinetry and wood floors. Bedroom features city views and closet with built in organizers. Attached balcony, in-unit laundry and 1 car gated garage parking. Prime Mission Bay location at Arterra- a premiere LEED-Silver luxury residential high rise. Enjoy a luxurious lifestyle with the sunny panoramic view roof deck & BBQ, fitness center, community room, private guest suite & 24/7 attended lobby. Located directly across the street from Mission Creek Park and the waterfront walking path. Steps to Caltrain, Muni & easy freeway access. 98 walk score. Walker's Paradise surrounded by eateries and entertainment like Oracle Park & Chase Center.
